_comment: Spelling variants -> canonical enemy name, for the Bestiary import (generate-foi-bestiary.ts).
Keys are matched after normalisation (NFC, curly quotes straightened, whitespace collapsed,
trailing '*' stripped) but are otherwise case- and punctuation-sensitive, because the two
sources disagree in exactly these seven places and nowhere else. Case folding everything
would hide a real second creature behind a casing difference, so each pair is listed by hand.
The generator FAILS on an unused alias: that means a source was corrected upstream and this
file is now lying about it.
